accountDeleted.body: The Spendly account for <address>{email}</address> was deleted on {changed_at}, with its orders, receipts and everything else in it.
accountDeleted.footer: This is the last email this account gets from Spendly.
accountDeleted.heading: Your account was deleted
accountDeleted.note: If this was not you, ask the person who runs this Spendly server.
accountDeleted.preheader: The Spendly account for {email} was deleted on {changed_at}.
accountDeleted.subject: Your Spendly account was deleted
chat.heading: Your conversation, {date}
chat.intro: Answered from your Spendly data as it was then. Amounts in {currency_name}.
chat.sentTo: You sent this to yourself from Ask, to <address>{email}</address>.
chat.sentWhen: It is sent only when you press Email this chat.
chat.subject: Your Spendly conversation, {date}

confirm.body: Hi {name}, open this link to confirm <address>{email}</address>. If you're not signed in on that device, sign in afterwards.
confirm.footer: Someone created a Spendly account with this address. If it wasn't you, ignore this email and the account stays unconfirmed.
confirm.heading: Confirm your email
confirm.note: It works once and expires in 24 hours.
confirm.preheader: Open the link to confirm {email}. It expires in 24 hours.
confirm.subject: Confirm your email for Spendly
email.buttonHelp: Button not working? Paste this into your browser:
email.notYou: If this was not you, reset your password and ask the person who runs this Spendly server.
email.twoStepFooter: We write to you whenever two-step sign-in is turned on or off.
passkeyAdded.body:
A passkey named {passkey_name} was added to
{email}
on {changed_at}. It can now sign in to your account.
passkeyAdded.footer: We write to you whenever a passkey is added to your account.
passkeyAdded.heading: A passkey was added
passkeyAdded.note: If this was you, there's nothing to do. If it wasn't, remove it in Settings and reset your password.
passkeyAdded.preheader: A passkey named {passkey_name} was added to {email} on {changed_at}.
passkeyAdded.subject: A passkey was added to your Spendly account
passwordChanged.body: The password for <address>{email}</address> was changed on {changed_at}.
passwordChanged.footer: We write to you whenever the password on your account changes.
passwordChanged.heading: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.note: If this was you, there's nothing to do. If it wasn't, reset your password: that signs you out everywhere else.
passwordChanged.preheader: The password for {email} was changed on {changed_at}. If it was you, there is nothing to do.
passwordChanged.subject: Your Spendly password was changed
recoveryCodeUsed.body:
A recovery code was used to sign in to
{email}
on {changed_at}. {codes_left} of 10 recovery codes are left.
recoveryCodeUsed.footer: We write to you whenever a recovery code is used.
recoveryCodeUsed.heading: A recovery code was used
recoveryCodeUsed.preheader: A recovery code was used to sign in to {email} on {changed_at}.
recoveryCodeUsed.subject: A recovery code was used for your Spendly account
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for <address>{email}</address>. If it was you, choose a new one.
reset.footer: Didn't ask for this? Ignore this email. Your password stays as it is.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.note: It works once and expires in an hour. Saving a new password signs you out everywhere else.
reset.preheader: Choose a new password for {email}. The link expires in an hour.
reset.subject: Reset your Spendly password
